title: Introductions
summary: Asking and saying who you are. Choose or type the word that fits the gap.

heter.note: heta, to be called: jag heter, du heter.

bor.note: bo, to live: one form for every person, jag bor, vi bor.

ar.note: Hur är det? asks how things are; vara, to be, is är for every person.

bra.note: bra, good or well, has no other forms.

traffas.note: träffas, to meet each other, ends in -s.

talar.note: tala and the everyday prata both mean to speak.
